QuestInfo.name: Gentle Breeze Fan
QuestInfo.1: Mar the Fairy says poor pets are getting worn out by the heat. However, a Gentle Breeze Fan would cool them right off. Eliminate monsters, find the Gentle Breeze they 'borrowed,' and bring it back to Mar the Fairy,

0.0: Eep! My pets! My poor pets! They're dying of heat stroke! Well, not dying, but they're tired. Real, real tired. If only I had my #e#bGentle Breeze Fans#k#n. I could use them to keep them cool and lovely and adorable. But mean monsters borrowed all my fans, and they won't give them back. Can you retrieve them for me,#h0#? Pretty please?

yes.0: The monsters pass the fans amongst each other, so I don't know who has them right now. You'll just have to eliminate them all! Get me #e#b5 of my Gentle Breeze Fans#k#n back! Only monsters between 11 levels below and 21 levels above you will carry them!

no.0: Oh, my poor pets. Look, I think one of them died. Oh, he's just wagging his tail. Still, it's just a matter of time.
